newsitem.title: USA: American Exploration finds natgas off Texas.
newsitem.headline: American Exploration finds natgas off Texas.

text.p: American Exploration Co said Tuesday its initial well drilled on Brazos Block 479, located in shallow waters offshore Texas, has discovered natural gas.

The well, which has been logged, encountered about 25 net feet of Miocene natural gas pay between 7,500 feet and 7,550 feet in depth. American Exploration holds a 75 percent working interest and Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance holds a 25 percent working interest.

"The discovery well on Block 479, which is adjacent to a previously announced discovery on Block 478, is being completed. The design and installation of production facilities for both blocks has been initiated and we would expect production to commence in late 1997," the company said.
"In the meantime, we plan to drill three or four additional wells to test adjacent prospective fault blocks on Blocks 478 and 479." ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
